summary:
Frontend UI validation for 6 modifications in /app/frontend/app/session/[episodeId].tsx. All 6 changes are correctly implemented and verified via live Playwright testing on mobile viewport (390x844) + code inspection.

1) Header design: ORANGE (#FF8C42, colors.primary) background verified, close X icon white on translucent rgba(255,255,255,0.2) circle, heart-circle icon + white title text - VERIFIED in header screenshots on all steps.
2) Video step: 'Regardez cette courte vidéo ensemble en famille' text is REMOVED - only video + 'Continuer' button visible - VERIFIED.
3) Bonus Mission title: Changed to 'Mission bonus... si tu l'acceptes' (line 896) and celebrationMessage/'À bientôt pour partager cette mission ensemble' block REMOVED - VERIFIED in code. Live UI render was not exercised because the test episode is already completed (already_completed=true) so backend returns bonus_mission=null and celebration screen shows 'Retour à l'accueil'. This is expected app behavior; the code change itself is correct.
4) LettersGame restricted alphabet ['B','T','R','E','A','M','J','O','C','N'] (line 479): 5 runs completed. All 20 letters observed are in the restricted list, all 4 letters per run are unique. Runs: [R,O,B,C] [R,T,E,J] [O,A,B,C] [O,M,R,C] [C,M,B,R].
5) 'Chacun trouve une qualité pour un autre membre...' text REMOVED after reveal (LettersGame post-reveal only renders lettersContainer). Post-reveal 'Chacun trouve' count = 0 on all runs - VERIFIED.
6) Non-regression: (a) Card titles display correctly ('Carte Vidéo / 1 chose que tu retiens de la vidéo ?') - VERIFIED; (b) Closing screen shows '1 mot pour résumer ce moment en famille ?' (count=1) and 'Ce mot apparaîtra sur votre mur familial' (count=1) - VERIFIED; (c) Pre-Démarrer: 'Nous avons terminé' button is HIDDEN (count=0) and appears only after Démarrer click (count=1) - VERIFIED.
